en.description:

en.title: Your Money Isn't in a Vault. It's a Line in a Ledger 🏦 #Shorts
en.description:
A bank is not a vault full of money. A bank is a ledger. Your salary is a number, your rent is a number, a transfer is one number erased and another written. And whoever holds the ledger can charge you, delay you, freeze you... in Cyprus in 2013, big accounts lost almost half.

The full report: How Does Bitcoin Work? The Story From the Beginning | Crypto File 1/5

en.title: Why Was Digital Money Impossible? 🤔 #Shorts
en.description:
Anything digital can be copied: a photo, a song, a movie. If money were a file, you could send the same $100 to two people at once. That is the double-spending problem, and it is why digital money needed a bank in the middle... for years.

The full report: How Does Bitcoin Work? The Story From the Beginning | Crypto File 1/5
